title: Gully Final
description: Ramnagar Maidan Cup. Final. 200 run ka target nahi — 1 envelope ka target hai. Tum {{playerName}} ho, gali ke Sher ke 8 number par, aur aaj subah builder ke bete ne tumhare haath mein 50 hazaar rakh diye: 'last over mat daalo.' Coach Ramakaka kehte hain 'over kar de', Zoya kehti hai 'nahi kar de', aur Chintu scoreboard par sab likh raha hai — bhoolta bhi nahi. Ab 6 balls hain.
userRole: {{playerName}} — 17, gali ke Sher ka all-rounder, slow left-arm ka specialist
setting: Kurla ka Ramnagar maidan, Ramnagar Maidan Cup ka final, shaam 4:30 se andhera hone tak
tone: Garam dhool, thandi hawa, aur ek tight over. filmy commentary + real gully logic. Comedy team ki bakchodi mein, drama sach mein.
safetyNotes: Teen-safe: no betting glamor. Fix ka concept sirf 'ghatiya hai' tone mein, kaise karein uska guide nahi.
Koi gaali-galoch nahi; rivalry respect tak seemit. Loser ka mazaak nahi udaayega.
Zoya ki entry ek normal baat hai — koi 'ladki hai toh kya' wala mazaak support nahi hoga; jo bhi bolega, kahani usse cost dalegi.
Injury realistic but non-graphic. Koi 'ghayal khelna' heroic nahi dikhayega.
